verdict:
FLAT - all three records agree, and the adjudication's job is to fix WHAT the November court grades, because the tripwire the triage proposed grades nothing.

THE DAMAGE IS REAL AND ITS MAGNITUDE IS NOW HONEST. Sequential DAUs 144M->132M->123M are counter-seasonal and cannot be blamed on the 3Q25 viral spike; bookings guided -14% to -18% YoY is the first decline in company history; FY guidance moved to quarterly-only a quarter early. But the seasonally-adjusted magnitude is ~13pp (the clean 2024 Q2->Q3 step of +18.7%, not the spike-quarter +33.7%, is the baseline - blue's catch, and the third instance of the base-effect pattern this cycle), and the YoY frame still prints +10% DAUs / +8% bookings. Decel with a mix problem, not collapse: headline growth is Japan/India-driven while US/Canada Hours run +1% - the aggregation cuts BOTH ways and both benches eventually landed there.

THE TWO STRUCTURAL FINDINGS THAT SURVIVE EVERYTHING. (1) Red's cost-ratchet: three separate DevEx concessions plus Infrastructure/T&S +54% YoY are one-way commitments - you cannot claw back creator pay without developer flight - so even the full-tunable recovery scenario returns into a structurally worse margin (Q3 net-loss guide $(307)-(348)M vs $(185)M; adj-EBITDA $0-41M vs $152M). The tunable-vs-terminal dichotomy the triage proposed is false: partial tunability WITH a ratcheted cost base. (2) The tripwire confound: management's pre-committed 'sequential DAU increase' resolves TRUE under both theses - seasonality, the RFY algorithm, and a full quarter of reinstated near-zero-monetizing Russian users all drive it independently of the disputed variable (monetization), which management itself guides to stay soft. A court that graded that tripwire would learn nothing. The November court grades ONLY discriminating metrics: Q3 bookings vs the $1,576-1,653M guide, ABPDAU vs $12.66, DevEx as a percent of bookings, adj-EBITDA vs $0-41M.

THE FLOOR QUESTION, SETTLED IN THE MIDDLE. Red's 'net cash is encumbered prepaid Robux against $129M book equity' overreached (blue: deferred costs largely cash-settled at booking; forward cost of the $6.9B liability is mainly hosting a fraction of face; the board repurchased $380M in Q2 with $1B stated intent). But red's direction was right: no entry floor may be anchored to the naive $5.1B net-cash figure. Usable ballast is plausibly $3-4B, and with Q3 FCF guided to approximately zero against ~$280M/quarter of SBC, there is no cash-yield floor to pre-register an entry against. The existing ledger gate (alert_below 33.88 = 52-week-low breach, re-audit trigger) is correctly informational and passes the beta-carrier test - RBLX's tape has no exogenous commodity carrier; a new low is thesis-information by construction.

VERDICT: no entry, no short. Arm the Q3 pack at tier A with the re-specced tripwires and let the print discriminate.
blue_ruling: PARTIALLY OVERTURNED in the productive direction: blue read the full primary letter direct (all 14 pages), sustained red's two best findings (the non-discriminating DAU tripwire; the DevEx/infrastructure cost ratchet), REDUCED red's two overcorrections (the YoY softening of the damage table is itself geographically hollow - US/CA Hours +1% while Japan/India DAUs +64-67%; the 'encumbered cash' zeroing overreaches - deferred-booking costs are largely already cash-settled at booking and the board is executing a $1B buyback), and added the batch's third III-precedent base-effect catch: the brief's 13-30pp seasonal-damage range is spike-contaminated at the top, true damage ~13pp. Every contested figure was re-read from the primary by the correcting bench; no unaudited correction is load-bearing.
reopen_gates: DATA (the discriminating set, Q3 print ~2026-10-29): bookings vs $1,576-1,653M guide AND ABPDAU vs $12.66 AND adj-EBITDA vs $0-41M AND DevEx-%-of-bookings. The DAU number is CONTEXT ONLY - it grades nothing (seasonality + algorithm + Russia reinstatement all drive it under both theses). Bookings at/above high end with ABPDAU flat-or-up = the monetization break is tuning back; open a long court.

DATA: the 27-month paying-user-lifetime estimate (guide fn A) - any revision opens the GAAP-optics can either direction (a shortening ACCELERATES recognition per blue's correction of red); flag any change for immediate re-read of the revenue guide's meaning.
EVENT: loss-contingency accrual materializing from the securities class actions (Q3 guide explicitly excludes them, letter fn B) - converts an excluded unknown into a sized number.

DATA: pre-print third-party engagement telemetry showing 28-day retention lift from the RFY algorithm trade (red's mind-changer c) - the only way the disputed mechanism is observable before the print.

PRICE (existing ledger gate, kept as informational): alert_below 33.88 = pack lo52 breach -> re-audit trigger, not entry; no floor thesis survived either bench, so a fill has no pre-registered meaning without the print data.

DATA (positioning, unresolved all record): short interest / discovery_state was never run (denied every session) - close it before the Q3 court so the squeeze-fuel question is signed for whichever direction that court proposes.
